notes: WArmy 0.4.39 — fix: tool operation records in the "Thinking & Execution" log are now fully localized to the UI language; English tool names no longer leak. Previously caoMingLocal fell back to de-underscoring the raw tool name (run_shell -> "run shell", plan_update -> "plan update") whenever an op.* i18n key was missing, which happened on the interrupt/restore ledger paths (op stored the raw tool name) and for any tool without a registered key. Now: (1) a new gongJuGuiFanKey normalizes every tool name and legacy alias to a canonical op key (synonyms grouped, e.g. read_docx/read_pdf -> read_document, open_file -> open_path, exec/run_command -> run_shell); (2) caoMingLocal resolves op.<key> -> normalized canonical key -> passes through already-localized legacy text (non-ASCII) -> and otherwise falls back to a localized op.generic, NEVER returning a raw English identifier; (3) the realtime ledger (gongJuMingZhongWen) now returns the canonical i18n key instead of hardcoded Chinese, so it localizes per language like the interrupt/restore paths; (4) the segment copy-summary (segText) and the stop-summary "recent: {op}" line also route through caoMingLocal. Added 46 new op.* keys covering all 54 tools + generic across all 27 locales (key sets equal, no CJK in non-CJK packs, no empty values, existing 11 keys unchanged). A new real-device probe probe-r240-op-local injects all tools + aliases + an unknown tool + legacy Chinese and asserts every operation row renders the correct local label with zero English/underscore leaks (run_shell -> 运行命令, plan_update -> 更新计划), plus static en-US key verification proving true i18n. Changed-area gates (syntax, naming, i18n-locales 448/0, locale-parity 151/0, broad suites, op-local probe, R239 scroll regression) passed three consecutive clean rounds. Carries all prior features unchanged.
